messages:
oliver: Heads-up - spotted a small cluster of provisional-only token rows after a routing fallback to cpu during a model-swap. delta ~450 tokens across 4 sessions.
mei: can you paste the session ids / query you used?
oliver: quick clickhouse: 
```
select session, sum(if(event='provisional_alloc', tokens,0)) as p, sum(if(event='confirmed_write', tokens,0)) as c
from tokens_events
where route='us-west-2' and event_time > now() - interval '1 hour'
group by session
having p>c
```
raj: pattern? toolcall truncation + immediate fallback?
oliver: yes - logs show truncated toolcall then router.fallback -> cpu confirmed_write but original provisional entry (tied to handoff id) never cleared. no handoff.finish emitted. snippet:
```
[2026-03-23T02:10:11Z] session=lmno event=handoff.start provisional=120
[2026-03-23T02:10:12Z] session=lmno event=toolcall.truncate
[2026-03-23T02:10:13Z] session=lmno event=router.fallback target=cpu-03 confirmed_write=120
# missing handoff.finish for handoff id abc
```
mei: short-term: ledger-sweep job to reconcile provisional rows when a confirmed_write exists. long-term: emit a canonical reconciliation marker from router when it performs forced confirmed_write on fallback, and dedupe on replay using x-replay-id header so retries don't double-provision.
raj: +1. also add metric tokens.orphaned_count and a dashboard panel with provisional/confirmed ratio per-route.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-03 created - "Orphan provisional tokens after fallback"
telemetry-bot: queued PR: add tokens.orphaned_count and reconciliation-audit topic.
oliver: i'll run a scoped sweep on affected customers tonight and post results to the incident. thanks.
